item.name: Register an SSH public key for the current user

request.name: Register an SSH public key for the current user

description.content:
### Description:
  Registers an existing SSH public key for the current user.
### Precondition:
  SFTP access must be enabled for the user's profile and role.
### Response:
  The SSH public key is registered.

response.name: The SSH public key was successfully registered.

item.name: Generate a new SSH public/private key pair

request.name: Generate a new SSH public/private key pair

description.content:
### Description:
  Generates a new SSH public/private key pair for the current user and registers the public key.
### Precondition:
  SFTP access must be enabled for the user's profile and role.
### Response:
  The generated SSH public/private key pair is returned.

response.name: The SSH key pair was successfully generated.

item.name: List the current user's SSH public keys

request.name: List the current user's SSH public keys

description.content:
### Description:
  Returns the list of SSH public keys registered for the current user.
### Precondition:
  SFTP access must be enabled for the user's profile and role.
### Response:
  A list of SSH public key records is returned.

query.description: Maximum number of SSH public keys to return.

response.name: The list of SSH public keys has been successfully returned.

item.name: List SSH public keys for a user

request.name: List SSH public keys for a user

description.content:
### Description:
  Returns all SSH public keys associated with the specified user.
### Precondition:
  The user must be an administrator. SFTP must be enabled for the user's profile and system role.
### Response:
  A list of SSH public keys for the specified user is returned.

variable.description: (Required) The unique identifier (UUID) of the entity.

response.name: The list of SSH public keys was returned successfully.

### Description:
  Creates a new SSH public key record for the specified user using a provided public key string.
### Precondition:
  The user must be an administrator. SFTP must be enabled for the user's profile and system role.
### Response:
  The SSH public key record is created successfully.
